product.title: Private Montserrat and Cava Winery Tour with Hotel Pick Up from Barcelona

description.text: Escape Barcelona for the day and combine two top attractions in one on this private full-day tour that includes Montserrat and a cava winery. Spend your morning exploring the mountaintop monastery of Montserrat, then head to the Penedes region to learn about cava production and sample wines and cavas paired with tapas and snacks. Stops include Montserrat Monastery, Natural Park of Montserrat, Sant Sadurní d'Anoia, Penedès. Winery hosts and drivers handle tasting and vineyard logistics so visitors can focus on Penedès cellars, cava, and Montserrat views. Ideal for visitors basing in Barcelona who want a guided city experience without coordinating metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
